_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for this plugin's hook rules. Consumed by hook-engine.sh (enforce), gen-hooks-doc.sh (docs), test-hooks.sh (fixtures). NEVER hand-edit deployed copy — edit here + build.sh switch.

rules.reason: Memory structure rule: unconditional loading of entry files is FORBIDDEN; MEMORY.md is an index, not a preload bundle. Individual files go in feedback/, project/, reference/, or user/ subfolders, never loose at root — CC loads all top-level .md files unconditionally, so this prevents 46k+ token waste (was ~25% of context) per session.
